citation: S. Gerstenkorn, P. Luc, Description of the absorption spectrum of iodine recorded by means of Fourier Transform Spectroscopy: the (B-X) system, J. Phys. (Paris) 46, 867-881 (1985), doi:10.1051/jphys:01985004606086700. Table III (Dunham coefficients, X valid to v'' = 19, B to v' = 80) and Table V first row (T00). Transcribed 2026-09-20 from the HAL copy jpa-00210032, page 872 and 876, digit by digit from 500 dpi renders; validated against the hannover2008 levels: G(v) within 0.002 cm-1 for X v'' <= 19 and B v' <= 43, B(v) within 3e-7 cm-1. Table IV (X-state D'', H'' Dunham coefficients; B-state exponential CDC polynomials) transcribed from page 875 the same way and checked against Table V's per-v values.
T00_note: Table V, E_v' at v' = 0: the distance between X(v''=0, J=0) and B(v'=0, J=0). Section 3.5 writes E(v) = G(v) + 15661.9408 cm-1 for the same quantity measured from the X potential minimum (T00 - G''(0) + G'(0) form).

X.cdc_form: D''(v) = sum_{i>=0} Y_i2 (v+1/2)^i, H''(v) = sum Y_i3 (v+1/2)^i (Table IV); E = G + B x - D x^2 + H x^3, x = J(J+1)

B.cdc_form: Table IV: D_v = exp sum_{i>=1} C_di (v+1/2)^(i-1); -H_v, -L_v, -M_v likewise with C_h, C_l, C_m (M_v is the effective M* = k M_v, k = 2.2, of the paper's fit). E = T00 + G'(v) - G'(0) + B x - D x^2 + H x^3 + L x^4 + M x^5 with x = J'(J'+1) and the paper's sign convention (its eqs. 3-4 write -D a^2 + H a^3 + L a^4 + M a^5 with H, L, M the tabulated negatives, so all four CDC terms lower the level).

indices: Y_i0 lists i = 1..n; Y_i1 lists i = 0..n
